speaker: john_heminges
text: The boxes are broken, and the snow kept some of the yard at home. Item, we count what came, not what the weather owed us. Margery, your box first, since you will stand over it anyway.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Count it. I am right to the penny. If you find me out, I will say so. You will be tired before I am wrong.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Right, to the penny. I say it once. The week, with Thursday in it, comes to thirty shillings a share. Best since Christmas. I am not going to say the sentence twice to make it feel larger.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Before the shares turn into a mood, the margin. Kemp's interest, Thursday: eleven lines. That is the first weekly total I have had to read. There is no song in it. I did not round it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Eleven. I remember each of them, and the yard remembered too, which is more than a margin does. And the interest on Burbage? What is the figure for the man who talked them into his pocket?

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Burbage has no column of that kind, Master Kemp. He says what is set down. Your column is the one that grows. I will not invent a twin for it to keep the peace.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the peace is a partial thing. You, Master Shakespeare. Thirty shillings, and my eleven written beside your comedy as if the eleven were a tax. Say something clever. You usually can, when it costs you nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty shillings.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirty shillings. Item, it is a share, not a story. Item, Edith's eight shillings lies under the candlestick, where it has lain, and it is not in this division. The stock owes it. Tonight does not pay it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Leave her paper where it is. I stood over my own box, not hers. The snow thinned the house and the house still paid. I am not asking the weather for a pardon.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Eleven lines, Thursday, and nothing since. If you added this afternoon, Master Kemp, you added it in a history, and a history is not this column. I was on the book. I ticked no new stroke.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I added nothing today. A thinned yard does not want a clown inventing on a king. You may write that I can be still, Abel. You will not enjoy it, and it will be true.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Noted, and not as a line of money. Will. When you have a Love's Labour's Won, the book will know where to go next. I ask it half in jest. The week has been good enough to bear a jest, and not so good that I mean a commission.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not written it. I am not going to. You may keep the title, John. It is a title. There is no play under it, and there will not be one because a Saturday went well.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Thirty shillings is what I came to hear, not a play that does not exist. My penny stands. His eleven lines stand. The eight shillings under the candle stand unpaid. I can hold three true things and go home in the snow.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And the fifty for the watchet is still the mercer's, Master Will, since we are naming what we are not paying. I do not keep that column. I only refuse to let a good share rub it out.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The fifty stands. The eight stands. The thirty goes into the purse, each man's own. I am not opening a coffer here. Item, that is the reckoning. Best since Christmas. The snow is the snow.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Best since Christmas, and my interest written down like a debt. I will take the thirty shillings. I will not take them as forgiveness, and I will not ask you for a joke you have already declined.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are finished. Thirty shillings. Eleven lines, Thursday. Edith unpaid. The gown unpaid. I have nothing clever to put on top of any of those, and I am not going to hunt for it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Go home while the snow is still only snow. A man who has been right about his money should not linger to become wrong about his evening. That is free advice, and it is the only thing I will not put in a box.

speaker: john_heminges
text: God give you a sound walk, Will. The share is yours. The jest I will make again some other Saturday, and you will refuse it again, and the books will remain honest. I can live with that.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The margin will remain eleven until you give me a different afternoon, Master Kemp. I have read it. I am shutting the book. Master Will, your copy was clean enough for a first week. I have said so. Do not ask me to say it warmer.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good night, then. Eleven is written. I heard you. I am not asking you to make it larger because of the snow.

speaker: margery_pell
text: And I am not asking for one penny more than the box. The snow is enough weather for one evening.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. Good night. The snow can have the rest of the street. I have a candle at home, and a coffer, and I know what I am not going to write in it.
